name: QuickBooks Online

definitions.documentation: One company-scoped QuickBooks Online Accounting API v3 get for Customer; fixed minorversion=75. Explicit environment sandbox/production and realmId in connection.config or node config; external OAuth bearer accessToken in RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or QUICKBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN/named secret. No OAuth consent, token refresh, ambient accounts, retries, pagination, batch, redirects or live-provider verification. All writes require confirmMutation=true, confirmFinancial=true and caller-owned requestId (1–36 safe ASCII): reuse only for intentional reconciliation of the same operation/body/realm; do not replay uncertain actions. Updates require current Id/SyncToken and add sparse=true. Stale object responses are redacted errors, never retried or transparently re-read. Money, rate, quantity and exchange values are exact bounded decimal strings on pins, emitted as JSON numeric literals without floating conversion; returned JSON numeric lexemes are retained exactly. Fractional exponent numeric responses are deliberately rejected by decimal contracts; provider totals/tax/currency semantics remain authoritative. Known-field projections omit private unknown properties. Resource-specific query supports only Id, active or transaction date bounds, explicit startPosition/maxResults up to100. Report nodes flatten ordered Header/ColData/Summary cells at depth<=12 and1000 rows, retaining cell values as strings. 100–30000ms total Date.now deadline starts before profile/secret lookup and covers serialization, transport, decoding and final cleanup; 256KiB requests,1MiB responses,16384 nonempty fragments,depth30/100000 values; numeric $retries=0 mandatory. No payment processing/card charges, bank secrets, void/delete/email/PDF/attachments/inventory tracking/tax setup/webhook listener. Accounting API scope, company entitlements, locale and valid chart/customer/item/tax references required. definitions.name: QuickBooks Update Customer
definitions.documentation: One company-scoped QuickBooks Online Accounting API v3 update for Customer; fixed minorversion=75. Explicit environment sandbox/production and realmId in connection.config or node config; external OAuth bearer accessToken in RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or QUICKBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN/named secret. No OAuth consent, token refresh, ambient accounts, retries, pagination, batch, redirects or live-provider verification. All writes require confirmMutation=true, confirmFinancial=true and caller-owned requestId (1–36 safe ASCII): reuse only for intentional reconciliation of the same operation/body/realm; do not replay uncertain actions. Updates require current Id/SyncToken and add sparse=true. Stale object responses are redacted errors, never retried or transparently re-read. Money, rate, quantity and exchange values are exact bounded decimal strings on pins, emitted as JSON numeric literals without floating conversion; returned JSON numeric lexemes are retained exactly. Fractional exponent numeric responses are deliberately rejected by decimal contracts; provider totals/tax/currency semantics remain authoritative. Known-field projections omit private unknown properties. Resource-specific query supports only Id, active or transaction date bounds, explicit startPosition/maxResults up to100. Report nodes flatten ordered Header/ColData/Summary cells at depth<=12 and1000 rows, retaining cell values as strings. 100–30000ms total Date.now deadline starts before profile/secret lookup and covers serialization, transport, decoding and final cleanup; 256KiB requests,1MiB responses,16384 nonempty fragments,depth30/100000 values; numeric $retries=0 mandatory. No payment processing/card charges, bank secrets, void/delete/email/PDF/attachments/inventory tracking/tax setup/webhook listener. Accounting API scope, company entitlements, locale and valid chart/customer/item/tax references required. definitions.name: QuickBooks Update Vendor
definitions.documentation: One company-scoped QuickBooks Online Accounting API v3 update for Vendor; fixed minorversion=75. Explicit environment sandbox/production and realmId in connection.config or node config; external OAuth bearer accessToken in RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or QUICKBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN/named secret. No OAuth consent, token refresh, ambient accounts, retries, pagination, batch, redirects or live-provider verification. All writes require confirmMutation=true, confirmFinancial=true and caller-owned requestId (1–36 safe ASCII): reuse only for intentional reconciliation of the same operation/body/realm; do not replay uncertain actions. Updates require current Id/SyncToken and add sparse=true. Stale object responses are redacted errors, never retried or transparently re-read. Money, rate, quantity and exchange values are exact bounded decimal strings on pins, emitted as JSON numeric literals without floating conversion; returned JSON numeric lexemes are retained exactly. Fractional exponent numeric responses are deliberately rejected by decimal contracts; provider totals/tax/currency semantics remain authoritative. Known-field projections omit private unknown properties. Resource-specific query supports only Id, active or transaction date bounds, explicit startPosition/maxResults up to100. Report nodes flatten ordered Header/ColData/Summary cells at depth<=12 and1000 rows, retaining cell values as strings. 100–30000ms total Date.now deadline starts before profile/secret lookup and covers serialization, transport, decoding and final cleanup; 256KiB requests,1MiB responses,16384 nonempty fragments,depth30/100000 values; numeric $retries=0 mandatory. No payment processing/card charges, bank secrets, void/delete/email/PDF/attachments/inventory tracking/tax setup/webhook listener. Accounting API scope, company entitlements, locale and valid chart/customer/item/tax references required. definitions.name: QuickBooks Create Invoice
definitions.documentation: One company-scoped QuickBooks Online Accounting API v3 create for Invoice; fixed minorversion=75. Explicit environment sandbox/production and realmId in connection.config or node config; external OAuth bearer accessToken in RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or QUICKBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN/named secret. No OAuth consent, token refresh, ambient accounts, retries, pagination, batch, redirects or live-provider verification. All writes require confirmMutation=true, confirmFinancial=true and caller-owned requestId (1–36 safe ASCII): reuse only for intentional reconciliation of the same operation/body/realm; do not replay uncertain actions. Updates require current Id/SyncToken and add sparse=true. Stale object responses are redacted errors, never retried or transparently re-read. Money, rate, quantity and exchange values are exact bounded decimal strings on pins, emitted as JSON numeric literals without floating conversion; returned JSON numeric lexemes are retained exactly. Fractional exponent numeric responses are deliberately rejected by decimal contracts; provider totals/tax/currency semantics remain authoritative. Known-field projections omit private unknown properties. Resource-specific query supports only Id, active or transaction date bounds, explicit startPosition/maxResults up to100. Report nodes flatten ordered Header/ColData/Summary cells at depth<=12 and1000 rows, retaining cell values as strings. 100–30000ms total Date.now deadline starts before profile/secret lookup and covers serialization, transport, decoding and final cleanup; 256KiB requests,1MiB responses,16384 nonempty fragments,depth30/100000 values; numeric $retries=0 mandatory. No payment processing/card charges, bank secrets, void/delete/email/PDF/attachments/inventory tracking/tax setup/webhook listener. Accounting API scope, company entitlements, locale and valid chart/customer/item/tax references required. Explicit environment sandbox/production and realmId in connection.config or node config; external OAuth bearer accessToken in RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or QUICKBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN/named secret. No OAuth consent, token refresh, ambient accounts, retries, pagination, batch, redirects or live-provider verification. All writes require confirmMutation=true, confirmFinancial=true and caller-owned requestId (1–36 safe ASCII): reuse only for intentional reconciliation of the same operation/body/realm; do not replay uncertain actions. Updates require current Id/SyncToken and add sparse=true. Stale object responses are redacted errors, never retried or transparently re-read. Money, rate, quantity and exchange values are exact bounded decimal strings on pins, emitted as JSON numeric literals without floating conversion; returned JSON numeric lexemes are retained exactly. Fractional exponent numeric responses are deliberately rejected by decimal contracts; provider totals/tax/currency semantics remain authoritative. Known-field projections omit private unknown properties. Resource-specific query supports only Id, active or transaction date bounds, explicit startPosition/maxResults up to100. Report nodes flatten ordered Header/ColData/Summary cells at depth<=12 and1000 rows, retaining cell values as strings. 100–30000ms total Date.now deadline starts before profile/secret lookup and covers serialization, transport, decoding and final cleanup; 256KiB requests,1MiB responses,16384 nonempty fragments,depth30/100000 values; numeric $retries=0 mandatory. No payment processing/card charges, bank secrets, void/delete/email/PDF/attachments/inventory tracking/tax setup/webhook listener. Accounting API scope, company entitlements, locale and valid chart/customer/item/tax references required. definitions.name: QuickBooks Create Bill
definitions.documentation: One company-scoped QuickBooks Online Accounting API v3 create for Bill; fixed minorversion=75. Explicit environment sandbox/production and realmId in connection.config or node config; external OAuth bearer accessToken in RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or QUICKBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN/named secret. No OAuth consent, token refresh, ambient accounts, retries, pagination, batch, redirects or live-provider verification. All writes require confirmMutation=true, confirmFinancial=true and caller-owned requestId (1–36 safe ASCII): reuse only for intentional reconciliation of the same operation/body/realm; do not replay uncertain actions. Updates require current Id/SyncToken and add sparse=true. Stale object responses are redacted errors, never retried or transparently re-read. Money, rate, quantity and exchange values are exact bounded decimal strings on pins, emitted as JSON numeric literals without floating conversion; returned JSON numeric lexemes are retained exactly. Fractional exponent numeric responses are deliberately rejected by decimal contracts; provider totals/tax/currency semantics remain authoritative. Known-field projections omit private unknown properties. Resource-specific query supports only Id, active or transaction date bounds, explicit startPosition/maxResults up to100. Report nodes flatten ordered Header/ColData/Summary cells at depth<=12 and1000 rows, retaining cell values as strings. 100–30000ms total Date.now deadline starts before profile/secret lookup and covers serialization, transport, decoding and final cleanup; 256KiB requests,1MiB responses,16384 nonempty fragments,depth30/100000 values; numeric $retries=0 mandatory. No payment processing/card charges, bank secrets, void/delete/email/PDF/attachments/inventory tracking/tax setup/webhook listener. Accounting API scope, company entitlements, locale and valid chart/customer/item/tax references required. definitions.name: QuickBooks Create BillPayment
definitions.documentation: One company-scoped QuickBooks Online Accounting API v3 create for BillPayment; fixed minorversion=75. Explicit environment sandbox/production and realmId in connection.config or node config; external OAuth bearer accessToken in RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or QUICKBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN/named secret. No OAuth consent, token refresh, ambient accounts, retries, pagination, batch, redirects or live-provider verification. All writes require confirmMutation=true, confirmFinancial=true and caller-owned requestId (1–36 safe ASCII): reuse only for intentional reconciliation of the same operation/body/realm; do not replay uncertain actions. Updates require current Id/SyncToken and add sparse=true. Stale object responses are redacted errors, never retried or transparently re-read. Money, rate, quantity and exchange values are exact bounded decimal strings on pins, emitted as JSON numeric literals without floating conversion; returned JSON numeric lexemes are retained exactly. Fractional exponent numeric responses are deliberately rejected by decimal contracts; provider totals/tax/currency semantics remain authoritative. Known-field projections omit private unknown properties. Resource-specific query supports only Id, active or transaction date bounds, explicit startPosition/maxResults up to100. Report nodes flatten ordered Header/ColData/Summary cells at depth<=12 and1000 rows, retaining cell values as strings. 100–30000ms total Date.now deadline starts before profile/secret lookup and covers serialization, transport, decoding and final cleanup; 256KiB requests,1MiB responses,16384 nonempty fragments,depth30/100000 values; numeric $retries=0 mandatory. definitions.name: QuickBooks Create Purchase
definitions.documentation: One company-scoped QuickBooks Online Accounting API v3 create for Purchase; fixed minorversion=75. Explicit environment sandbox/production and realmId in connection.config or node config; external OAuth bearer accessToken in RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or QUICKBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN/named secret. No OAuth consent, token refresh, ambient accounts, retries, pagination, batch, redirects or live-provider verification. All writes require confirmMutation=true, confirmFinancial=true and caller-owned requestId (1–36 safe ASCII): reuse only for intentional reconciliation of the same operation/body/realm; do not replay uncertain actions. Updates require current Id/SyncToken and add sparse=true. Stale object responses are redacted errors, never retried or transparently re-read. Money, rate, quantity and exchange values are exact bounded decimal strings on pins, emitted as JSON numeric literals without floating conversion; returned JSON numeric lexemes are retained exactly. Fractional exponent numeric responses are deliberately rejected by decimal contracts; provider totals/tax/currency semantics remain authoritative. Known-field projections omit private unknown properties. Resource-specific query supports only Id, active or transaction date bounds, explicit startPosition/maxResults up to100. Report nodes flatten ordered Header/ColData/Summary cells at depth<=12 and1000 rows, retaining cell values as strings. 100–30000ms total Date.now deadline starts before profile/secret lookup and covers serialization, transport, decoding and final cleanup; 256KiB requests,1MiB responses,16384 nonempty fragments,depth30/100000 values; numeric $retries=0 mandatory. No payment processing/card charges, bank secrets, void/delete/email/PDF/attachments/inventory tracking/tax setup/webhook listener. definitions.name: QuickBooks Create RefundReceipt
definitions.documentation: One company-scoped QuickBooks Online Accounting API v3 create for RefundReceipt; fixed minorversion=75. Explicit environment sandbox/production and realmId in connection.config or node config; external OAuth bearer accessToken in RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or QUICKBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN/named secret. No OAuth consent, token refresh, ambient accounts, retries, pagination, batch, redirects or live-provider verification. All writes require confirmMutation=true, confirmFinancial=true and caller-owned requestId (1–36 safe ASCII): reuse only for intentional reconciliation of the same operation/body/realm; do not replay uncertain actions. Updates require current Id/SyncToken and add sparse=true. Stale object responses are redacted errors, never retried or transparently re-read. Money, rate, quantity and exchange values are exact bounded decimal strings on pins, emitted as JSON numeric literals without floating conversion; returned JSON numeric lexemes are retained exactly. Fractional exponent numeric responses are deliberately rejected by decimal contracts; provider totals/tax/currency semantics remain authoritative. Known-field projections omit private unknown properties. Resource-specific query supports only Id, active or transaction date bounds, explicit startPosition/maxResults up to100. Report nodes flatten ordered Header/ColData/Summary cells at depth<=12 and1000 rows, retaining cell values as strings. 100–30000ms total Date.now deadline starts before profile/secret lookup and covers serialization, transport, decoding and final cleanup; 256KiB requests,1MiB responses,16384 nonempty fragments,depth30/100000 values; numeric $retries=0 mandatory. No payment processing/card charges, bank secrets, void/delete/email/PDF/attachments/inventory tracking/tax setup/webhook listener. Accounting API scope, company entitlements, locale and valid chart/customer/item/tax references required.
